FN-4USU5II-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 113
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/08/2025
Senate Bill 113 as introduced would appropriate $524,276,588 from the Education Trust Fund
(ETF) for fiscal year 2025 to various agencies and entities to be used pursuant to the provisions
of this bill.
